imd.name: IMD API (district warnings, rainfall, nowcast, basin QPF)
imd.detail: IMD_API_KEY is not set. Register at https://api.imd.gov.in/public/register.php, then set the key as an environment variable / secret. IMD also describes an IP-whitelisting step.
blockers: IMD API key required (and possibly IP whitelisting by IMD)

imd_geoserver.name: IMD public district-warning map service (undocumented)
imd_geoserver.detail: IMD's own map site uses this public service, but it is not a documented API and terms are unclear. Disabled by default; enable only after IMD's nodal officer confirms programmatic use is allowed.
